mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, we have clear skies near the Verona Public Library, and tonight you can catch the International Space Station rising in the south over Belleville and heading east toward Fitchburg, appearing low on the horizon for three minutes starting at 5:43 PM.

The city is moving forward with the Military Ridge State Trail paving project to ensure year-round accessibility, and residents can attend an informational meeting on December 8th at the Senior Center to learn more about the upcoming detours and construction schedule.

Today you can enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, or the pizza and a pitcher special at the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, trivia fans have plenty of options with events at The Mill, The Bogey Factory, and Hop Haus Brewing.
On October 25, officers arrested a man for an O W I offence after finding him unresponsive in his vehicle at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Stop by for a scoop of the delicious Chocolate Caramel Twist before the store closes at 10:00 PM tonight.
